name: Collar of Beast-Speech
body:
Aura faint divination and enchantment; CL 4th; Slot neck; Price 2,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This stylish black leather and gold-studded collar confers the ability of speech upon an animal. If the wearer is a non-magical natural beast, the collar grants the ability to speak and understand Common. It does not, however, increase the beast’s Intelligence. On other creatures, it prevents the wearer from speaking or understanding Common.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, comprehend languages, speak with animals; Cost 1,000 gp.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
